description: French submission artifacts (T13). Builder-center article declaring the Policy pattern, a demo script, the French architecture/decisions/demo/securite notes, and a refreshed root README. Depends on all prior features (it describes the finished dual-mode architecture, the Policy pattern, the UI+API run flow, and token revocation). Independent of nothing - it comes last so it describes what actually shipped.
steps: Create docs/builder-center-article.md (French): declare the submission pattern = Policy; include ONE sentence framing the handler as 'the same Policy decision sitting in the tool path, like a guard' WITHOUT ticking Guardrails as a submission pattern; note the prototype limits (CORS '*', no auth).
Create docs/demo-script.md (French): a demo video script under 3 minutes, ~70% driving/conduite flow and ~20s on the QCM showing 'meme cerveau' (same Decider brain for both modes).

Create the French design-section-13 notes: docs/architecture.md (double circuit exam/situation, single Lambda backbone, declared Policy pattern, no agent loop in production), docs/decisions.md (settled decisions S1-S7 and their rationale), docs/demo.md (switch mode, upload a photo, read cards/scores, show debug + elapsed_ms), docs/securite.md (revoke the exposed HF token, read via env/Secrets Manager, CORS + auth to harden before production).

Update root README.md: pitch, the Policy pattern, and how to run the UI + API (build web/, deploy stacks, set VITE_API_URL, call /uploads then /query). Keep client-test.html as a documented fallback (do not delete it).
acceptance_criteria: docs/builder-center-article.md, docs/demo-script.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/decisions.md, docs/demo.md, docs/securite.md all exist and are in French (AC16).
The article declares Policy as the submission pattern and does NOT tick Guardrails; proto limits (CORS '*', auth) are noted.
README documents how to run the UI + API and keeps client-test.html as a fallback.
The securite note documents HF token revocation and env/Secrets Manager handling.
findings:
